description:
Search, read, manage, compose, and send email messages.

Actions (required params -> optional):
- search (-> account, query="UNSEEN", folder="INBOX", limit=20)
- read (account, uid -> folder, preview, max_chars)
- mark_read / mark_unread / flag / unflag (account, uid|uids -> folder)
- move (account, uid|uids, destination -> folder)
- archive / trash (account, uid|uids -> folder)
- new (account, to, subject, body -> cc, bcc, attachments)
- reply (account, uid, body -> to, folder, attachments)
- forward (account, uid, to, body -> folder, attachments)

Read preview mode returns at most max_chars (default 4000) and includes truncation metadata; omit preview for the full body.

Query examples: "UNREAD", "FROM user@example.com", "SINCE 2026-01-01", "UNREAD FROM boss@company.com". Date format MUST be YYYY-MM-DD.

Outbound bodies support plain text or HTML. Attachments use base64 content, max 10 files and 25MB decoded total.

account.description: Account email filter (optional, defaults to all for search)

attachments.description: File attachments to include (optional). Max 10 files, total decoded size <= 25MB.

body.description: Email body (required for new/reply/forward). Use plain text or HTML, not both.

max_chars.description: Preview body limit, integer 1-100000; defaults to 4000 when preview is true

preview.description: Read at most max_chars and return truncation metadata

query.description: IMAP search query (default: UNSEEN). Single: UNREAD, FLAGGED, SINCE YYYY-MM-DD, FROM email@example.com, SUBJECT text. Combined: UNREAD SINCE 2026-01-01, UNREAD FROM user@example.com. Dates MUST use YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-03-21). Plain text is treated as subject search.

to.description: Recipient email address (required for new/forward, optional for reply - auto-derived from original sender)

name: messages
